units.CD4404-bumba-2: This unit covers the rural Lolo and Yamongili secteurs and the rural part of Bumba secteur in Bumba territory, Mongala province, including the Lolo centre (Mongbandi/Likwangola), the Yamongili area and the Siforco logging concession around Mohonge. Mongala is far from the eastern and Mai-Ndombe/Kwilu conflict zones, and no armed group is known to hold territory here. Order is kept by the Congolese National Police (PNC) through posts at secteur and groupement centres, alongside secteur and customary authorities. The main security issues are banditry, local land and customary disputes and tensions around logging concessions, none of which amounts to armed-group control. No web research was possible in this run because the search budget was exhausted, so the assessment rests on default state presence.
units.CD4404-bumba-1: This unit covers Bumba town (the main port and commercial centre of Mongala province on the Congo River) and the rural Yamaluka and Yambuku secteurs of Bumba territory. Mongala lies far from the eastern and Mai-Ndombe/Kwilu conflict zones and no armed group is known to hold territory here. Day-to-day order in Bumba town's health-area neighbourhoods is kept by the Congolese National Police (PNC), with FARDC units also stationed in the town; rural villages fall under PNC posts and customary/secteur authorities. Security issues are banditry, local land/customary disputes and occasional unrest, none amounting to armed-group control. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, fetch blocked), so the assessment rests on default state presence.
